sentences.text: Mohanlal vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023

Author: Gautam Chowdhary
Bench: Gautam Chowdhary
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 79 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 8291 of 2023 Applicant :- Mohanlal Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Atharva Dixit,Aushim Luthra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material on record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-Mohan Lal for enlarging him on bail in Case Crime No.98 of 2017 under Sections 498A, 318, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Balrai, District Etawah.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is the husband and he has been falsely implicated in present case.
He further submits that the marriage of the applicant was solemnised with the deceased on 10.07.2016 in a simple and ideal manner.

Learned counsel next argued that there are general allegations against all the accused persons including the applicant and that the father and mother in-laws, who have been assigned same role as to the applicant, has already been enlarged on bail vide order dated 01.04.2022 and 20.10.2022 passed in Criminal Misc.

sentences.text: . He next submits that the trial is at 313 Cr.P.C. stage and there is every possibility that the applicant would be acquitted and therefore, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed before the Court.
The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been mentioned.

It has also been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required and is also ready to accept all the conditions which the Court may deem fit to impose upon him.
He next submits that applicant is languishing in jail since 25.03.2017, having no criminal history.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that the applicant is the husband of the deceased and his innocence cannot be adjudged at pre trial stage,
therefore, he does not deserve any indulgence.
In case the applicant is released on bail he will again indulge in similar activities and will misuse the liberty of bail.

Perusal of the record shows that the marriage between the applicant and the deceased was solemnised on 10.07.2016 and deceased died within a short span of eight months of the marriage due to demand of dowry.
The dying declaration has also been recorded, wherein specific allegation has been levelled against the applicant.

Keeping in view submissions of learned counsel for the parties, gravity of offence, nature of allegations and all the attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, no case for bail has been made out.
Accordingly, the bail application of applicant-Mohan Lal is rejected.

However, considering the period of incarceration of applicant and the fact that the material witnesses have already have examined, the learned trial Court is directed to make all possible endeavours to decide the aforesaid case expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months from the date of production of a certified copy of order before it.
Order Date :- 21.2.2023 S.Ali  Mohanlal vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182503802/
